title.zh: 机械能守恒 · 过山车的能量账本
title.en: Conservation of Mechanical Energy · The Roller Coaster’s Energy Ledger

desc.zh: 动能和重力势能此消彼长、总数不变；一旦有摩擦，少掉的机械能变成热，账本照样是平的。
desc.en: Kinetic and gravitational potential energy trade off while the total stays fixed; add friction and the missing mechanical energy shows up as heat, so the ledger still balances.
